tasks.title: Create and Switch to Lab Model
tasks.instructions: Ensure the model `mod7-troubleshoot-lab` exists and is the active target.
hints: Run `juju switch mod7-troubleshoot-lab` or `juju add-model mod7-troubleshoot-lab`.

tasks.title: Deploy Workload Node
tasks.instructions: Deploy the `ubuntu` charm with application name `worker-node` into `mod7-troubleshoot-lab`.

tasks.title: Inspect Unit Agent Logs via Remote Execution
tasks.instructions: Execute a remote check on `worker-node/0` to verify that the unit agent log file `/var/log/juju/unit-worker-node-0.log` exists and is readable.

tasks.title: Replay Recent Debug Logs
tasks.instructions: Practice reading past debug logs without blocking by executing a replay command on the active model.
